2. Typography & Inline Semantics

Body copy uses the system font stack with fluid root sizing via clamp(100%, 95% + 0.4vw, 125%). Links like primary link, secondary link, and contrast link step along Paul Tol's qualitative lightness ladder on hover.

Inline elements include strong, emphasis, highlighted mark, inserted text, deleted text, inline code, Ctrl + K, and PTCS (hover or focus for tooltip).

"The contrast ratio between each colour in the dark scheme and white is at least 4.5 for people with moderately low vision."
— Paul Tol, SRON Notes on Colour Schemes

Unordered List

  • Qualitative schemes: Bright, High-Contrast, Vibrant, Muted
  • Cell-highlight schemes: Pale and Light
  • Text & line scheme: Dark

Preformatted Code

:root {
  color-scheme: light dark;
  --tc-bg: light-dark(var(--tol-white), var(--tol-black));
}

5. Extended Components

Accordion: Why drop Sass/SCSS?

Modern Baseline CSS provides light-dark(), color-mix(), clamp(), and @layer natively, eliminating 3x duplicated variable blocks and shrinking the stylesheet by over 85%.

Accordion: Strict Paul Tol Lightness Ladder

All solid UI states step across pale, light, medium-contrast, bright, dark, and high-contrast schemes.
